C0062.title: Chongqing Police Dismantle Aphrodisiac Fraud Ring Posing as Medical Experts
C0062.summary: Wanzhou police in Chongqing dismantled an aphrodisiac fraud ring and arrested 20 suspects. The report stated that the gang packaged low-cost medicinal powder as a so-called miracle drug and used false promotion and scripted sales tactics to induce victims to buy expensive products; a product sold for more than 1,300 yuan cost only a little over 10 yuan. The case reflects a health-product fraud chain involving false advertising and high-price inducement.
